entities.summary: Sampo Koskinen is a Finnish football coach and a former professional footballer. As a player, he spent most of his career in his native country with FC Honka. He also played for Eliteserien side Sandefjord Fotball, in the Netherlands for RBC Roosendaal and for Swedish clubs IFK Göteborg and Boden.
